notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Free Demo
notes.content:
Hush: In Search of Dominic Ward is part of Steam Next Fest! Please try the free Performance Test Demo to experience the opening cinematic sequence of the the game. If you have questions or feedback, please provide it here!

notes.title: Performance Demo now Available
notes.content:
The performance test demo for Hush: In Search of Dominic Ward is now available on Steam. This short single player demo contains only the introduction section of the game. It contains no puzzles as all the puzzles in the game are designed with 2 players in mind. Its purpose is to allow players to evaluate the games performance costs on their VR system before purchasing the final product. There are graphical settings available in the options menu to allow for lower end systems to enjoy the game, though it will be at the cost of graphical complexity.

We hope this short teaser demo excites you with the story and world of the game we are building!


Update! Subtitles and loading improvements have been added to the performance demo in preparation for the Steam Next Fest!
